description: Tree maps and sunbursts: treemap takes a TreeNode tree with value on the leaves and colour where you say so, here a red-to-green ramp for the day's move like a market map, with the sector label over its block and a click that selects a holding; tree on a sunburst draws the same hierarchy as rings, and drillable with bind:drillPath zooms into the ring you click and gives the breadcrumb back; specToTreemap builds the tree from rows. Free, in @svgrid/grid.

faq.question: What shape does a tree map take?
faq.answer: A TreeNode: name, value on the leaves, children on the branches, and an optional color per node. Branches are sized from their children.

faq.question: How do I colour the cells by a second measure?
faq.answer: Compute the colour per leaf and set color on the node. The demo maps the day's percentage move onto a red-to-green ramp.

faq.question: How does drilling down work?
faq.answer: Set drillable on the sunburst. A click zooms into that ring; bind:drillPath holds the path for a breadcrumb, and setting it back to an empty array zooms out.
